notes: Assumptions that change the number: 2.2 kg leg with ~75 % edible meat and fat (bone is the rest); lean and fat taken at the USDA 1/8" trim value rather than 1/4", to allow for the rendered fat that step 8 spoons off; 1.5 kg potatoes and 2 onions in the tin; the 'little oil' for the potatoes in step 4 is not an ingredient line, so it is not counted; gravy from 2 tbsp flour and 500 ml stock. Sanity check: USDA roast leg of lamb (FDC 174373) is 242 kcal / 100 g cooked. If 1650 g raw edible roasts to ~1155 g, the cooked basis gives 349 kcal of lamb a serving against our raw-basis 431, so if more fat runs off our figure is up to ~80 kcal high. The web search budget ran out before a published per-serving figure for a roast with potatoes could be found.
